operation.description: Observe the active sequence through the supplied read-only UXP panel.

projectPath.description: Exact absolute path identity of the open saved Premiere project; its bytes are not read.

sequenceName.description: Exact name of the active sequence to inspect; no sequence is selected or modified.

fps.description: Integer sequence rate: 24, 25, 30, 50 or 60. Fractional/drop-frame rates are unsupported.

width.description: Expected sequence frame width; rendered dimensions are not inspected.

height.description: Expected sequence frame height; rendered dimensions are not inspected.

sourcePath.description: Exact absolute native source path identity; no source-content readback.

startFrame.description: Zero-based source frame at the sequence timebase; default 0.

frameCount.description: Positive duration in sequence frames; out points are exclusive.

clips.description: Ordered contiguous clips on the sole unmuted video track, at zero-based timeline positions.
